LanguageData.WeazelEssenceWeaver.label: Essence Processing
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceWeaver.description: Unlocks foundational techniques for processing raw Essence. This research allows your colony to weave harvested Essence into usable Essence Silk.
LanguageData.WeazelWeazelSlavesuit.label: Efficient Domestication
LanguageData.WeazelWeazelSlavesuit.description: Unlocks the fabrication of specialized prisoner garments designed to periodically harvest Essence from captives.
LanguageData.WeazelGAMIncubation.label: G.A.M. Incubation Theory
LanguageData.WeazelGAMIncubation.description: Unlocks the construction of a specialized incubator designed to cultivate G.A.M. artificial muscles utilizing Essence.
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceRefiner.label: Essence Refining Technology
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceRefiner.description: Unlocks the construction of the Essence Refiner, a facility intended for purifying raw Essence. Currently, this building has no practical effect.
LanguageData.WeazelPowerArmor.label: Artificial Muscle Fiber Replication
LanguageData.WeazelPowerArmor.description: Unlocks the fabrication of advanced power armor integrated with G.A.M. artificial muscles.
LanguageData.WeazelBioGenerator.label: Applied Artificial Biology
LanguageData.WeazelBioGenerator.description: Unlocks the construction of the G.A.M. Bio-Generator, a facility that generates electrical power by utilizing G.A.M. artificial muscles.
LanguageData.WeazelPowerWeapon.label: Weapon Upscaling
LanguageData.WeazelPowerWeapon.description: Unlocks the fabrication of massive heavy weapons. Due to their extreme weight and monstrous recoil, these weapons can only be wielded by units equipped with power armor.
